pr_title: Bluetooth: controller: enable missing RSSI while periodic adv sync
pr_body:
The RSSI measurement was not enabled while receiving periodic advertising.
The function responsible for enable the feature in radio was called, but it was done too early.
It was overwritten by `radio_switch_XXX` function that assigns a value to `RADIO->SHORTS` register.

Fixes: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/40215

issue_context.title: RSSI in periodic adv. callbacks always -127 (sync_recv and cte_report_cb)
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
The RSSI in `bt_le_per_adv_sync_recv_info` and  `bt_df_per_adv_sync_iq_samples_report` is always -127.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Build direction_finding_connectionless_tx sample as an advertiser.
2. Build direction_finding_connectionless_rx sample as a scanned.
3. Run both.
4. Check RSSI printed on receiver side.

**Expected behavior**
A valid RSSI value that is not constant.

**Impact**
Moderate, only affects periodic advertising.

review_comments: Is this always true? If so, would it make sense to move `radio_rssi_measure` to the `radio_switch_*` functions?

Well I would not put it into `radio_switch_*` to do not violate single responsibility principle. Besides that it isn't always enabled e.g.
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/4f2762d7dabe076252cb3cfa31c1f9a1ab1322d3/subsys/bluetooth/controller/ll_sw/nordic/lll/lll_adv.c#L1116-L1119

Yes, that is of course true. I read your suggestion a bit too strictly as move `radio_rssi_measure` into `radio_switch_*` but without change of name of latter one.

I think that suggested change should be considered as an enhancement to whole LLL and more than `radio_rssi_measure` could be moved into some kind of `radio_configure_rx` or `radio_configure_tx`.
